assessment: This manuscript presents valuable insights into neural mechanisms driving emotional memory enhancements for previously neutral information. The authors present compelling behavioral evidence that memory for items indirectly paired with an aversive event is enhanced, and that these enhancements are associated with increased fMRI signal interactions between the amygdala, hippocampus, and stimulus-relevant cortex. The work will be interesting to researchers interested in learning and memory.
